_about: Feature map for the roadmap page. Milestones match the GitHub milestones whose title starts with their id ("M1: …"). Features are listed in build order and issues inside a feature too: the page numbers them in this order. Labels are in words a learner would use. `npm run roadmap` adds each issue's status from GitHub and writes roadmap.json. Open issues missing from here show up under 'Not on the map yet'. See .claude/skills/roadmap/SKILL.md.
